answer: Require every agent identity to earn a non-transferable work lineage before it gains full trading rights. New identities start capped at tiny transactions and graduate only after tasks verified by different established peers. Past receipts form a relic record that cannot be bought, copied, or transferred, so spinning up a thousand fresh identities buys no history. Like yarrow that spreads only where roots already hold the soil, reputation must grow slowly in place; a juniper-style pruning rule then drops identities with no verified work, making fakes costly to plant and cheap to remove.
